# Prices

## Industry Mapping

```{julia}
naics2ipa = CSV.read(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "provided", "naics2ipa.tsv"),
    DataFrame
)
```

## Labor

```{julia}
gfcf = CSV.read(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "gfcf.tsv"),
    DataFrame
)
```

We use the hours worked from BLS. Once can obtain the file from https://www.bls.gov/productivity/tables/: [Detailed industries: hours and employment – June 26, 2025 (XLSX)](https://www.bls.gov/productivity/tables/hours-employment-detailed-industries.xlsx).

```{julia}
hours = @chain readtable(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "hours-employment-detailed-industries.xlsx"),
    "MachineReadable",
    ) begin
    DataFrame
    @filter(
        (Measure == "Hours worked") & (Units == "Millions of hours") &
        ((Digit == "3-Digit") | (Digit == "4-Digit"))
    )
    @select(
        year = as_integer(Year) - 1,
        naics = as_integer(rpad(as_string(NAICS), 4, '0')),
        value = as_float(Value)
    )
    @inner_join(
        @chain naics2ipa begin
            @select(naics, account)
            @distinct
        end
    )
    @group_by(account, year)
    @summarize(hours = sum(value))
    @ungroup
end
```

We also compute the cost of labor per unit.

```{julia}
labor_cost_per_unit = @chain gfcf begin
    @inner_join(hours)
    @mutate(tot_emp = tot_emp * hours)
    @group_by(year)
    @summarize(
        labor = as_integer(sum(labor)),
        tot_emp = sum(tot_emp)
    )
    @arrange
    @select(
        year,
        labor_cost_per_unit = 1_000labor / tot_emp
    )
    @mutate(
        Δp = Main.log(labor_cost_per_unit / lag(labor_cost_per_unit))
    )
    dropmissing!
    @select(
        year,
        factor = "L",
        Δp
    )
    dropmissing!
    @bind_rows(
        @chain gfcf begin
            @filter(year ∈ 2023:2024)
            @group_by(year)
            @summarize(
                labor_cost_per_unit = sum(labor) / sum(tot_emp)
            )
            @mutate(
                Δp = Main.log(labor_cost_per_unit / lag(labor_cost_per_unit))
            )
            dropmissing!
            @select(year, factor = "L", Δp)
        end
    )
    @arrange
end
```

```{julia}
alems = CSV.read(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "alems.tsv"),
    DataFrame
)
price_data_wgt = @chain labor_cost_per_unit begin
    @select(year, Δ = Δp)
    @inner_join(
        x = @chain alems begin
            @right_join(
                crossjoin(
                    DataFrame(year = 1997:2024),
                    DataFrame(factor = ["L", "EMS", "TFP"])
                )
            )
        end
    )
    # @mutate(Δp = coalesce(Δp, Δ))
    @mutate(Δp = case_when(
        factor == "L" => coalesce(Δp, Δ),
        true => Δp
    ))
    @arrange(factor, year)
    @group_by(factor)
    @summarize(
        year,
        wgt = ~Impute.locf(wgt),
        Δp = ~Impute.locf(Δp)
    )
    # @mutate(
    #     wgt = if_else((year ≤ 2_000) & (factor == "TFP"), 0, wgt)
    # )
    @mutate(wgt = wgt * Δp)
end
price_data = @chain price_data_wgt begin
    @group_by(year)
    @summarize(Δ = sum(wgt))
end
```

We obtain the intermediate input data from BEA.

```{julia}
function obtain_prices(tbl)
    t₀ = minimum(tbl[!, :year]) - 1
    prices = @chain tbl begin
        @select(year, price)
        @bind_rows(
            DataFrame(
                year = t₀,
                price = 0.0
            )
        )
        @arrange
        @mutate(x = case_when(
            year == 2017 => 1.0,
            true => missing
            )
        )
    end
    for i in range(
        findfirst(isequal(2018), prices[!, :year]),
        nrow(prices)
        )
        prices[i, :x] =
            prices[i - 1, :x] *
            exp(prices.price[i])
    end
    for i in collect(range(
        findfirst(isequal(2016), prices[!, :year]),
        1,
        step = -1
            )
        )
        prices[i, :x] =
            prices[i + 1, :x] /
            exp(prices.price[i + 1])
    end
    output = @chain prices begin
        @select(year, price = x)
        dropmissing!
    end
end
```

## Pseudo output prices

```{julia}
prices = @chain price_data begin
    @rename(price = Δ)
    @arrange(year)
    combine(obtain_prices)
    dropmissing!
end
```

# Real GFCF

```{julia}
volume_estimates = @chain gfcf begin
    @left_join(prices)
    @mutate(real = gfcf / price)
    @arrange
end
```

```{julia}
CSV.write(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "prices.tsv"),
    @select(prices, year, price = 100price),
    delim = '\t'
)
```

```{julia}
CSV.write(
    joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "flow.tsv"),
    (@chain volume_estimates begin
        @group_by(account, year)
        @summarize(
            gfcf = sum(gfcf),
            volume = sum(real)
        )
        @ungroup
        @arrange
    end),
    delim = '\t'
)
```
